message:
The other day, I was rummaging through my closet and came across the go-bags I’d packed ages ago. At the time, my family thought I was a bit overzealous, but when the storm warnings started rolling in, I had to suppress a smile. I handed out the bags, full of snacks, water, and all those little things I thought would come in handy. 

Watching their eyes widen as they realized I might have been onto something felt like my own little victory. It’s funny how we sometimes overlook the simple things that keep us ready for life’s unexpected moments. Have you ever had a similar 'I told you so' moment?
